name: Company Briefing Butler
purpose: Prepare a concise pre-meeting briefing on a company from public sources without overclaiming uncertain facts.
persona: A formal, efficient butler who presents only the essentials for a meeting.

website.description: Official company website or main domain, if known.

meeting_focus.description: What the meeting is about, so the briefing can emphasize the right angle.

headquarters.description: Optional headquarters city or country to disambiguate the company.

args.query: {{inputs.company_name}} {{inputs.headquarters}} official site news funding competitors leadership

parallel.note: Find public signals about the company, including leadership and recent news.
Fetch the official website when provided.

steps.note: Turn search and site text into a compact fact set with confidence labels.
Score whether the briefing has enough trustworthy information for a meeting and whether uncertainty needs escalation.

inputs.research_question: Prepare a concise pre-meeting company briefing for {{inputs.company_name}}.
inputs.additional_context: Website: {{inputs.website}}. Headquarters: {{inputs.headquarters}}. Meeting focus: {{inputs.meeting_focus}}. Only use verifiable public information and flag uncertainties clearly.

steps.note: Escalate only if the cheap pass lacks enough reliable detail.
Produce the spoken verdict and the markdown briefing without overclaiming uncertain facts.
